toegepas.voor: Dit het hulle nodig om energie te kry
toegepas.na: Jou lyf het hulle nodig om energie te kry
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit' directly after 'die kos wat jy eet' can be read as the food rather than the body; naming the body removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit' follows directly after 'die kos wat jy eet', so a reader can take it as the food instead of the body.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the body fixes a pronoun that could point two ways, without changing the meaning or touching a protected word.

toegepas.blok: Proteïene: kos vir groei en herstel
toegepas.voor: Jou lyf bou nuwe vel met proteïen wanneer 'n sny aan jou knie gesond word
toegepas.na: Wanneer 'n sny aan jou knie genees, bou jou lyf nuwe vel met proteïen
toegepas.rede_vinder: A cut 'genees' rather than 'word gesond', and fronting the clause avoids two consecutive sentences opening with 'Jou lyf bou'.
toegepas.fout: Two sentences in a row open with 'Jou lyf bou', which reads wooden, and 'gesond word' is a flat way to say a cut heals.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'genees' is the natural verb for a cut, and putting the clause first breaks the repetition; same people, action and meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en meet so albei pakke met dieselfde maat
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en vergelyk so albei pakke met dieselfde maatstaf
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The learner compares the packs rather than measuring them; 'vergelyk ... met dieselfde maatstaf' is the natural expression and matches the block heading.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'met dieselfde maat meet' is a fixed Afrikaans expression that fits both the literal per-100 g column and the comparison, while 'maatstaf' is harder and narrows it.
